benchmark: M20 — W1 product benchmark: the shipped path (product launcher + product extension build), measured

labels.measured: read from a clock or an OS/browser counter during this run, on this machine
labels.derived: arithmetic on measured figures in this record (named in each field)
labels.projected: none in this record: the contract's projected budgets (benchmark-contract.md Rule 5) describe a different architecture (a server VLM over redacted frames) and are not compared here

extension.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:8995/v1/chat/completions; style-src 'sha256-ZYRp1TbYj9bPuYCw1S2y0R5L4r911NcNjTciEbHTsAo='; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

environment.perception: DOM/text structure only in this workload: the product build captures no frame without the person's toolbar gesture (ADR-0009), and this harness makes none

workload.tenStepNote: A step is one pipeline pass (one turn). A single task is capped at MAX_TASK_TURNS = 5 and that cap is not raised here; the contract's "ten-step task" is met as 6 bounded tasks run back to back in one browser and one model process, 15 steps in all.
workload.approvals: answered by this harness through the control plane's grant path, not by a person; the wait is reported as grantMs and excluded from machineMs

outcomes.label: measured
outcomes.note: every task is included in the latency tables whatever its outcome; a failed or refused turn contributes the stages it reached

latency.label: measured (stage timings: RunRecord.timings, monotonic clock in the offscreen document); machineMs is derived = totalMs − grantMs − clarifyMs
latency.percentileMethod: nearest rank: the sample at 1-based rank ⌈p/100 · n⌉ of the n sorted samples; n is given per stage; a stage with no samples is null

coldFirstStep.note: the first step after the launcher and the browser started: first model inference, first extension run

taskWallMs.label: measured by the harness around each control-plane task, including messaging and approval polling

networkFreeSteps.label: derived: steps minus POSTs to the reasoner endpoint seen by CDP in the offscreen document

cacheHitRate.label: not applicable
cacheHitRate.note: no screen-state cache exists in this build

launcher.note: verifyMs: full SHA-256 of weights and runtime; modelLoadMs: llama-server spawn to healthy. The OS file cache may already hold the weights: this is a cold PROCESS start, not a cold disk.

resources.label: measured (OS counters via Get-Process, every ~500 ms; JS heap via CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage, every ~500 ms); peaks are the largest sample unless named otherwise

gpuMemory.label: not measured
gpuMemory.note: no GPU backend is in this path: the model runs on llama.cpp's CPU build and no ONNX/WebGPU session is created in this workload

tierFiring.label: measured (counts from the extension's own port report)

timeline.clock: monotonic, ms since the harness started

notAClaim: one machine, one browser, one backend, synthetic pages; a small number of runs — no reliability rate, no cross-machine claim
not a J7 experiment and not a privacy-metric run; J7/B5 remain open
